name: icons-pro-max
description: Portable icon catalog and rendering guidance with bundled brand assets for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Find bundled payment, social, technology, AI provider, and connector marks; copy the selected asset into the current project and apply its rendering guidance. Includes provenance and third-party notices. Example application paths are adapted to the user's project. The plugin supplies a skill and local files, with no hosted service, account connection, payment codes, or automatic project changes. Brand marks remain the property of their owners.
defaultPrompt: Find the bundled icon assets for my interface.
Audit my interface for distorted or inconsistent icons.
